skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 5 combo hits, dealing 40% ATK DMG each, and has a 50% chance to inflict [Stun] on the target for 1 turn (cannot act; at most 4 characters per side can be under stun-type states at the same time).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 5 combo hits, dealing 40% ATK DMG each, and has a 50% chance to inflict [Stun] on the target for 1 turn (cannot act; at most 4 characters per side can be under stun-type states at the same time).Additionally has a 50% chance to gain 50% reflected DMG on self for 2 turns.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When attacked by an enemy, if the last hit is a Critical Strike, Hammerhead has a 50% chance to enter [Tenacity] state (power is 20%); otherwise has a 50% chance to enter [Berserk] state (power is 30%).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When attacked by an enemy, if the last hit is a Critical Strike, Hammerhead has a 100% chance to enter [Tenacity] state (power is 20%); otherwise has a 100% chance to enter [Berserk] state (power is 30%).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When attacked by an enemy, if the last hit is a Critical Strike, Hammerhead has a 100% chance to enter [Tenacity] state (power is 35%); otherwise has a 100% chance to enter [Berserk] state (power is 30%).

effects.desc: The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
